observations: Photo 0: a used petrol car engine out of the vehicle, sitting on a dirty workshop or spare-parts market floor among other engines and gearboxes.
Photo 0: wiring harness and a relay or fuse block still attached on top, intake ducting, throttle body, accessory pulleys and belt, oil filler cap visible; the layout looks like a V-type engine.
Photo 0: a separate gearbox or transfer unit sits to the lower left; it is not clear whether it belongs with this engine.
Photo 0: no engine code, badge, plate or stamped serial is readable anywhere in the shot.
Photo 0: overlaid dealer watermark 'VICTOR MAZECO' and a 'posted on Jiji' mark; camera stamp 'SPARK 30C' at the bottom. This is a reposted advert image, not a fresh shot for this sale.
Only one photo; no clip of the engine running, no compression or oil check.

identity.kind: used car engine (V-type petrol, said to be for a Lexus)

claims.evidence: No badge, engine code or stamp is readable in photo 0. The engine type cannot be confirmed from this one shot.
There is no Lexus LX460 model; the seller may mean GX460, LS460 or LX470, which use different engines at different prices. Nothing in photo 0 settles which.
Origin and history of the engine cannot be shown in a photo; would need import or auction paperwork.

risks.risk: The engine code is unknown, so it may not be the 4.6 V8 the buyer expects; a smaller or different engine is worth far less.
risks.proof: Close photo of the engine code stamped on the block and the VIN or ID sticker, plus a photo of the top cover or valve cover badge.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced; the engine model sets the price

risks.risk: Engine may not run: seized, knocking, low compression, or overheated.
risks.proof: Short clip of the engine started on a test stand, showing a cold start, idle and the exhaust, with the seller's handwritten code in shot.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged parts: ECU, starter, alternator, harness, sensors, or a cracked block hidden from this angle.
risks.proof: Photos of both sides, front and back of the engine and the underside, plus a photo of the ECU and harness if included.
risks.if_unproven: as a bare long block without ancillaries

risks.risk: Gearbox in the frame may or may not be part of the sale.
risks.proof: Seller's statement plus a photo of exactly what is included, laid out together.

risks.risk: Reused dealer advert photo; the actual unit for sale may differ from the pictured one.
risks.proof: Fresh photo of the engine with a handwritten note carrying today's date and a code we supply.
risks.if_unproven: held until the fresh photo arrives

proof_requests: Close photo of the stamped engine code on the block and any ID or VIN sticker on the engine.
Fresh photo of the same engine with a handwritten note showing today's date and a code we give.
Clip of the engine running on a stand: cold start, idle, revving, with exhaust and any smoke visible.
Photos of all four sides and underside of the engine, and of the parts included (ECU, harness, starter, alternator, gearbox).
Oil filler cap open and dipstick out, showing oil condition.
response.reason: This is a used car engine but no engine code or badge is readable, and the seller names a Lexus model that does not exist, so even a worst case price depends on which engine it is. An engine code photo is needed before it can be priced.
